annotations.note: Cash balances include project escrow accounts protected under Dubai Law No. 8 of 2007. Disbursements require independent engineer certification against construction progress, insulating project assets from corporate creditors.
Off-plan revenue recognized strictly under IFRS 15 percentage-of-completion. Massive contracted backlog provides 2.5-3.5 years of forward revenue coverage.
Land bank held at historical acquisition cost; revalued market appraisal provides substantial asset cushion (>3.0x net debt).

verdict.summary: BBB+/Baa1 net-cash IG credit ($11.87bn net cash at 30-Sep-26) backed by AED 158.8bn ($43.2bn) revenue backlog and AED 19.7bn 9M26 EBITDA (+19% YoY). Repaid $750m Series 3 sukuk from cash in Sep-26. Primary credit risk is Dubai residential price cyclicality (~75% off-plan sales) and HoldCo vs Emaar Development cash ring-fencing.

positives: Deep net cash balance sheet: AED 51.2bn ($13.94bn) cash vs AED 7.6bn ($2.07bn) gross debt at 30-Sep-26 after retiring the $750m Sep-26 sukuk.
Multi-year earnings visibility: AED 158.8bn ($43.2bn) revenue backlog (+6% YoY) underpins deliveries through 2029.
Rating momentum: Upgraded to BBB+ (S&P) and Baa1 (Moody's), both Stable, in Jun-25.
Strong 9M26 operating cash flow of AED 17.6bn ($4.79bn) covering capex and AED 4.4bn special dividend.
negatives: Cyclical Dubai residential exposure: ~82% of backlog is UAE development (~75% off-plan); early signs of Dubai price moderation (-1.7% YoY in Aug-26).
Recurring EBITDA (malls, hospitality, commercial leasing) accounts for ~31% of consolidated EBITDA; cyclical development drives ~69%.
Restricted RERA escrow vs unrestricted HoldCo cash split is not fully transparent in quarterly releases.

background.business_overview: UAE's largest master real estate developer across Dubai Hills, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Creek Harbour, Emaar Beachfront, plus Emaar Malls and international arms.
background.asset_perimeter: Emaar Properties PJSC (HoldCo) holds majority stake in listed Emaar Development PJSC plus wholly owned malls/hospitality.
background.ownership_governance: Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD) is largest minority/sovereign-linked shareholder (~22%); listed on DFM.

recent_drivers: 9M 2026: Revenue AED 37.5bn (+13% YoY), EBITDA AED 19.7bn (+19% YoY), Net profit AED 17.1bn (+17% YoY).
Sep 2026: Full repayment of $750m Series 3 sukuk cut gross loans & sukuk 22.3% to AED 7.6bn.
Special dividend: Board approved AED 4.4bn ($1.2bn) one-time special dividend alongside Emaar Development plans.

catalysts.impact: Confirms FY26 cash conversion, escrow split, and Emaar Development stake/capital return structure.
